fields.name: crew_id
fields.description: Identifies a crew member. If possible, this should match other internal agency crew or employee IDs. The same crew_id may appear in multiple records over time as the crew member's role changes.

fields.name: crew_role
fields.description: Primary role of the crew member during the period this record covers. When vehicle_crew.crew_role is populated for an assignment, it takes precedence over this value.

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: Date this crew record becomes effective. A crew member has one effective crew record at a time, carrying their primary role; a different role on a specific assignment is recorded in vehicle_crew.crew_role rather than in an overlapping crew record.

fields.name: end_date
fields.description: Date this crew record is no longer effective. This date is exclusive, meaning the record covers dates from start_date up to but not including end_date, matching vehicle_crew.end_time. Empty if currently effective.

name: crew.schema.json
description: Transit personnel who serve as vehicle or station crew, including operators, conductors, and fare inspectors.
